name: ChartEditBench
intro: ChartEditBench 是一个面向多轮图表编辑的基准，要求模型在连续对话中维护共同上下文、根据视觉反馈修改代码并完成图表更新，用于评估 grounded chart editing 能力。
build_method: 难度控制的多轮修改链, 人工验证子集, 程序化评测
metric: Execution Rate, Instruction Following Score, Visual Similarity, Logical Code Verification
modality: 图像, 文本, 代码, 多模态
task_type: 多轮图表编辑, 代码生成
eval_feature: 执行保真度检查, 像素级视觉相似度, 逻辑代码验证
intro_en: ChartEditBench evaluates grounded multi-turn chart editing in multimodal language models. It measures whether models can keep common ground, update plotting code, and follow iterative editing instructions over time.
build_method_en: Difficulty-controlled multi-turn edit chains, human-verified subset, programmatic evaluation
metric_en: Execution Rate, Instruction Following Score, Visual Similarity, Logical Code Verification
eval_feature_en: Execution-based Fidelity Checks, Pixel-level Visual Similarity, Logical Code Verification

flowchart LR
    spec_queues["图表 / 编辑类型配比"]

    initial_backoff["退避 ≤3 次"]
    validation_discard["丢弃失败链"]
    initial_rendered["初始渲染状态"]
    next_edit["生成下一轮编辑"]
    validate_turn["本轮编辑有效？"]
    turn_retry_gate["仍可重试？"]
    turn_backoff["退避 ≤3 次"]
    edit_rendered["编辑后渲染状态"]
    five_done["已完成五轮？"]
    edit_chains["保留编辑链"]
    final_dataset["4,142 条链 · 20,710 次编辑"]
    vqa_generation["每张图 5 个 VQA"]

    spec_queues --> initial_chart
    initial_chart --> validate_initial
    validate_initial -->|有效| initial_rendered
    validate_initial -. 无效 .-> initial_retry_gate
    initial_retry_gate -->|重试| initial_backoff
    initial_retry_gate -. 已耗尽 .-> validation_discard
    initial_backoff --> initial_chart
    initial_rendered --> next_edit
    next_edit --> validate_turn
    validate_turn -->|有效| edit_rendered
    validate_turn -. 无效 .-> turn_retry_gate
    turn_retry_gate -->|重试| turn_backoff
    turn_retry_gate -. 已耗尽 .-> validation_discard
    turn_backoff --> next_edit
    edit_rendered --> five_done
    five_done -. <5 .-> next_edit
    five_done -->|完成 5 轮| edit_chains
    edit_chains --> final_dataset
    initial_rendered -.-> vqa_generation
    edit_rendered -.-> vqa_generation
    vqa_generation -.-> vqa_asset
    edit_chains -.-> qa_assets
    final_dataset -.-> human_subset
